overview.description: The ProShares Short Financials (SEF) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Financial Select Sector index. The fund provides inverse exposure to a market cap-weighted index of S&P 500 financial stocks. SEF was launched on Jun 12, 2008 and is issued by ProShares.
